title: Knight-Backed Kiss
setup: The black king is stuck in the corner, and your knight on f5 already watches g7 — the square right beside it.
hint: The queen wants to stand beside the king. Which of your pieces already guards that square?
explanation:
## The Idea

This is the same queen kiss, backed by a knight instead of a king. The knight on f5 guards g7, so the queen can land there safely.

{{Qg7#}} gives check. The king on h8 cannot take the queen, and g8 and h7 are covered by it. A check from the next square cannot be blocked.

Any guard will do for the kiss: king, knight or pawn. Find the guarded square beside the enemy king.
